source.title: Worst Case Scenario
source.description:
Time is now against us. The dreadlord mentioned Demon Fall Canyon, so the good news is we know where they are headed. The bad news is that we've likely strengthened Azgaloth's anchor to Azeroth with our failed ritual. Even if we slay Azgaloth now, he would soon manifest himself again.

I have an idea. It's desperate, but it might be our only hope. There's someone in Andorhal with a very particular set of skills that might be able to help, but we'll need to build some trust with her first.
source.objective: Travel to Andorhal and locate Gregory to learn what to do next.
source.completion:
The reliquary of Uther's blood was the key to that ritual, but it was unfortunately lost in the attack. As I said before, this magic is all about building and breaking connections. If we could find another sample of that blood we use could against Azgaloth's physical form and slay him to banish his soul from Azeroth completely.

How much do you know about bronze dragons?
